CoMakingSpace WorkBee · v1.02 board reference

Duet 6HC v1.02 board reference · installed WorkBee wiring unknown

233 source positions on 46 separate reference interfaces; 0 installed contacts, 0 routes, 0 guesses. The schematic identifies this board revision. It does not identify the revision or harness fitted to the CoMakingSpace WorkBee.

OPEN = no SmoothieBox connection established. GUESS = a dotted proposed route with an explicit endpoint and interface; no GUESS route is drawn here. Driver numbers are source channel numbers, not WorkBee axes. No DB25 is evidenced.

The complete board schedule preserves all 48 J / 9 JP references and 264 board marks, plus eight separately named RJ45 socket contacts. Ethernet module solder pins, configuration contacts and external socket contacts retain separate numbering domains.

Explicit scope and omissions
  • J40, J44, J47 and J51 are absent from this revision, not invented empty connectors.
  • Processor and TMC2160 package pins, MOSFET/transceiver/PHY leads, mounting holes, fiducials, fuses and component terminals are not external board connector inventories.
  • TP1–TP39 are schematic test points marked DNP on Headers sheet 2/8; they are not fitted external connectors and are not plotted as machine endpoints.
  • USB-C A2/A3/A10/A11/B2/B3/B10/B11 are not instantiated in the exact 16-contact USB2.0 symbol/footprint; no 24-pin generic USB-C inventory is substituted.
  • J46 internal module solder pins 1–14, J29/J52 configuration header pins, and JP1–JP9 remain individually listed in the board appendix rather than the external machine reference diagram.
  • No DB25, installed motor-to-axis binding, endstop assignment, router-control contact, safety-chain route or SmoothieBox conductor is established.

Function/net evidence is from the revision-matched schematic. The pinned CAD/iBOM is used for physical footprint and pad identities. No MCU/TMC package pins are presented as external sockets. Source paths are qualified by sheet/file to distinguish reused symbol labels.
